content:
Apple has officially announced the date for its major September event, using the tagline "Surprise and shine," a clever play on the English idiom "rise and shine." The event is expected to mark the first unveiling of Apple's foldable iPhone.

Meanwhile, in mainland China, Apple's tagline designed for the local market reportedly contains a similar "foldable" easter egg, according to Google Translate.

Before the official reveal of the "Surprise and shine" tagline, Apple fans anticipating the first foldable-screen iPhone had been speculating about possible event taglines, with many guesses centered around "unfolding"-related puns such as "the best is yet to unfold."

In mainland China, Google Translate at least considers the English translation to be nearly a perfect match in meaning.

If you take a screenshot of Apple's China website event promotional image and run it through Google Translate's image translation feature, you get the following machine translation: "A new chapter unfolds, dazzling and brilliant."

Results from other translation tools vary, but with just two weeks to go before this highly anticipated event, it is at least a fun and entertaining warm-up easter egg.
